zh-CN: 在功能中心添加「刚刚怎么了」，开启全屏回放后，可用按钮或自定义快捷键保存刚过去的 15 秒。画面在本机缓存，MP4 保存到「影片 / NuPhy Lab / Replays」。关闭回放或锁屏会清空未保存的画面。
en: Add Instant Replay from Feature Center. Turn it on to save the last 15 seconds of your display with a button or a custom shortcut. Silent clips are buffered locally and saved as MP4 files in Movies / NuPhy Lab / Replays. Turning replay off or locking your Mac clears the unsaved buffer.
